preconditions.description: The lengths of permutations a and b satisfy the given constraints.
The lengths of the input lists a and b match the given sizes n and m.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n for ai in a)
preconditions.description: All elements in permutation a are distinct integers between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= bi <= m for bi in b)
preconditions.description: All elements in permutation b are distinct integers between 1 and m.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for d in range(-m, m+1) if is_subsequence([ai + d for ai in a], b))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of distinct integers d such that the sequence c is a subsequence of b.
